description:
The ReqView example project is open showing the SRS (Software Requirements Specification) document. A requirement has been pre-added with the text 'The system shall enforce a minimum password length of 12 characters for all user accounts.' Its current Status attribute is set to 'Draft'.

Find this requirement in the SRS document (search for the text 'minimum password length') and update its Status attribute from 'Draft' to 'Ready'.

Click on the requirement row to select it, then find the Status attribute field in the attributes panel and change the value to 'Ready'.
